palette.notes: Clips show night city scenes: teal, indigo and plum shadows with warm lantern, window and neon accents (pink, orange, red). Code did not measure these sheets.

lighting: Night or dusk lit by practicals: shop windows, vending machines, paper lanterns, neon signs; small warm pools of light in a cool dark street.
silhouette: Buildings, wires, trees and lanterns stack into a busy skyline; street furniture reads as dark shapes against lit windows.

motion.timing: From the sheets: frames across 40 s look nearly identical, so motion is small and local (flicker, falling petals, steam), not scene-wide. Not measured.

texture: Dense detail at a low resolution: signage, cables, clutter; petals and puddle reflections.
camera: Locked frame, often low street-level views looking up; no camera move in any loop seen.

acting.enters: No characters seen; a parked car and empty streets.
acting.acts: The city performs: a light flickers, petals fall, a screen glows.
acting.depth: Near street, mid buildings, far skyline; lit windows deep in the frame draw the eye back.

techniques: cinemagraph: frozen scene with one or two small loops
warm practical lights in a cool night palette
dense low-res detail with clear value grouping
feel: cool dark street + warm practical lights + one tiny loop = cozy, alive cinemagraph
for_fred: Set Fred's scenes as a cinemagraph: a frozen cozy backdrop with one tiny loop (lantern flicker), so when Fred leaves the frame still lives, and his return is the big change. Light him with a warm practical in a cool scene.
